gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.760985 36.173714)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
slope_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES', 111120) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(s.rast, 1, o.pt) AS slope_degrees
FROM slope_rast s, origin o;

  SELECT

      ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-82.760985, 36.173714), 4326), 3857)
    )
)
SELECT 
  ST_Value(slope_rast, 1, ST_Transform(geom, 3857)) AS slope_degrees
FROM 
  raster_slope, point_geom;
